footer.text: surgeMedia · open-source, self-hosted media management platform.

form.requiredNote: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required.

validation.email: Enter a valid email address, for example name{'@'}example.com.
validation.tooLong: This field must not exceed {max} characters.
validation.tooShort: This field must contain at least {min} characters.
validation.emailTaken: This email address is already used by another account.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.slug: Use only unaccented lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. marketing-site).
validation.slugTaken: This identifier is already used by another project.

meta.title: Self-hosted media management and processing
meta.description: surgeMedia centralises your images and media, transforms them on demand and delivers them to your applications through a secure API.

hero.title: Your media, under your control.
hero.description: Centralise the images of all your projects, crop, resize and optimise them on demand, then deliver them to your applications through a secure API, on your own infrastructure.

example.caption: An image transformation in a single URL

features.title: Everything you need to serve your media

transform.title: On-demand transformations
transform.description: Cropping, resizing, WebP or AVIF conversion and compression, generated on first request and then cached.

api.title: Secure API
api.description: Per-project access tokens, fine-grained permissions and allowed CORS origins for each application.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
selfHosted.description: Your files and data stay with you: SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, local or object storage.

sdk.title: Ready-to-use components
sdk.description: Optimised images, galleries and uploads for Vue, React and Svelte, whatever your framework.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to access the surgeMedia administration.
login.noAccount: No account or forgotten password? An administrator of your organisation can send you an access link.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.invalid: The information entered is not valid.
errors.unexpected: Sign-in failed. Please try again in a moment.

notices.passwordSet: Your password has been saved. You can now sign in.
notices.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

bootstrapWarning.title: Bootstrap credentials still set
bootstrapWarning.description: Your administrator account exists: remove NUXT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL and NUXT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the server environment, then restart it.

upcoming.title: Section in progress
upcoming.description: This section will be available in an upcoming release. Your role already grants you access to it.

tokens.title: Personal tokens
tokens.description: Create tokens for your scripts, tools and integrations: they act with your permissions, on the projects you choose.

ADMIN.label: Administrator
ADMIN.description: All privileges: users, every project and the library.

EDITOR.label: Editor
EDITOR.description: The organization library and the media of the projects they belong to.

DEVELOPER.label: Developer
DEVELOPER.description: The library, project creation, API keys and integrations of the projects they belong to.

unauthorized.title: Sign-in required
unauthorized.description: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: Your role does not grant access to this page. Contact an administrator if needed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The requested address does not exist or has been moved.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.description: The service could not process the request. Please try again in a moment.

common.unexpectedError: The operation failed. Please try again in a moment.

list.title: Users
list.description: Accounts with access to the administration and the role of each one.
list.caption: List of users

fields.name: Name
fields.activeHint: A deactivated account can no longer sign in and its sessions are closed immediately.

create.title: New user
create.description: Create the account, then send the invitation link to the person concerned.
create.invitationNote: No password is set here: an invitation link valid for 7 days will be generated so that the user chooses their own password.

edit.selfRoleHint: You cannot change your own role.
edit.selfActiveHint: You cannot deactivate your own account.

access.title: Access and security

pending.invitation: An invitation link is pending until {date}.
pending.reset: A reset link is pending until {date}.

access.sessionsRevoked: No session closed. | {count} session closed. | {count} sessions closed.
access.inactiveHint: Reactivate the account to generate a link.

link.label: Link to send
link.once: This link will not be shown again: copy it now and send it through a secure channel.

invitation.title: Invitation link
invitation.description: Send this link to {email}: it lets them choose their password and activate their account.

reset.title: Reset link
reset.description: Send this link to {email}: it lets them choose a new password. The current password remains valid until then.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Deletion is permanent. To suspend access while keeping the history, deactivate the account instead.
delete.confirmDescription: The account {email} and its sessions will be permanently deleted. The media it uploaded are kept.

errors.selfAction: You cannot change the role of, deactivate or delete your own account.
errors.lastAdmin: Not possible: this account is the last active administrator.

invitation.title: Activate your account
invitation.description: Choose the password for your surgeMedia account.

reset.title: New password
reset.description: Choose a new password. Your open sessions will be closed.

invalid.title: Invalid or expired link
invalid.description: This link has already been used, has expired or has been replaced. Ask an administrator for a new link.

fields.passwordHint: {min} characters minimum. A phrase of several words is both secure and easy to remember.

PUBLIC.label: Public
PUBLIC.description: Accessible to anyone with the address, and cached by browsers and CDNs.

PRIVATE.label: Private
PRIVATE.description: Accessible only from the administration or with a signed temporary link.

list.title: Library
list.description: Media for the whole organization, reusable in any project by duplication.
list.trashDescription: Media removed from delivery. Restore them or delete them permanently.
list.count: No media | {count} media item | {count} media items
list.empty: No media yet: upload your first images above.

upload.title: Upload images
upload.dropHint: Drag and drop your images here, or
upload.dropHintSingle: Drag and drop the new image here, or
upload.constraints: Accepted formats: {types}. Maximum size: {max} per file.

errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the maximum size ({max}).
errors.UNREADABLE_FILE: The file is unreadable or damaged.
errors.DIMENSIONS_TOO_LARGE: The image is too large (more than 100 million pixels).
errors.KIND_MISMATCH: The new file must be of the same type as the original.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The file has just been replaced by someone else. Reload the page and try again.

detail.loadError: Unable to load this media item.
detail.readOnly: You can view this media item, but not change it.
detail.archivedProject: This media item's project is archived: it is read-only.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: Optional. Also used for the readable name in the file address.
fields.altTextHint: Describe what the image shows for people who cannot see it (about 125 characters). Leave empty if the image is purely decorative.

links.title: File address
links.publicDescription: Permanent address to use in your websites and applications. It changes if the file is replaced.
links.privateDescription: This media item is private: generate a temporary link to share it or display it outside the administration.

replace.title: Replace the file
replace.description: The identifier, title, alternative text and visibility are kept. The file address changes: old addresses redirect to the new one.

trash.title: Move to trash
trash.description: The media item will no longer be delivered, but can be restored from the trash.
trash.moved: "{name}" has been moved to the trash.
trash.bannerTitle: This media item is in the trash
trash.bannerDescription: It is no longer delivered: its addresses return a 404 error.
trash.confirmDescription: "{name}", its file and its variants will be removed from storage. This action cannot be undone.

organize.title: Duplicate or move
organize.description: Duplicating creates an independent copy with its own address. Moving changes the media item's space without changing its address.
organize.moveDisabled: Choose another space to move the media item.
organize.noTargets: No space allows you to add media.

OWNER.label: Owner
OWNER.description: The whole project: settings, members, API keys and media.

DEVELOPER.label: Developer
DEVELOPER.description: API keys, allowed origins and media.

list.title: Projects
list.description: A project groups the media, members and access of an application and its environments.
list.caption: Project list
list.emptyMember: You are not a member of any project. Ask a project owner to add you.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It identifies the project in tools and SDKs.
fields.slugAutoEmpty: Optional. If left empty, it is derived from the name.
fields.descriptionHint: Optional. For example the application and environments involved.

create.title: New project
create.description: You will become its owner and can then add members.

archived.title: Archived project
archived.description: The project is read-only: its media are still delivered, but no upload or change is possible.

archive.title: Archive the project
archive.description: The project becomes read-only: its media are still delivered, but no upload or change is possible anymore. Archiving is reversible and is required before deletion.
archive.restoreDescription: The project can be changed again.

delete.title: Delete the project
delete.description: Permanently deletes the project, its members and its folders. You will choose what happens to its media.

library.label: Move them to the library
library.description: They are still delivered at the same address.

purge.label: Delete them permanently
purge.description: Their files and derivatives are erased from storage.

delete.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the project identifier: {slug}
delete.confirmMismatch: The identifier you typed does not match.

members.title: Members
members.description: People with access to the project and their roles.
members.caption: Project members
members.adminNote: Administrators can access every project, even without being members.
members.capped: Acts as {role} (limited by their platform role).
members.removeConfirmDescription: This person will lose access to the project and its media.
members.leaveConfirmDescription: You will lose access to the project and its media.
members.removed: {name} has been removed from the project.

add.title: Add a member
add.searchHint: Name or email address. Only active accounts that are not already members are listed.
add.added: {name} has been added to the project.

errors.PROJECT_ARCHIVED: The project is archived: this action is not possible.
errors.LAST_OWNER: Not possible: the project must keep at least one owner.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This account is already a member of the project.
errors.ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: This role exceeds what their platform role allows.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: This account no longer exists or has been deactivated.
